back: A component that lets current flow in one direction only.
Forward: conducts above about 0.6–0.7 V. Reverse: very high resistance, almost no current.
The triangle points in the direction conventional current can flow.

front: Shape of a diode's I–V graph?
back: Flat (no current) in reverse and below about 0.7 V forward, then rising steeply.

front: Why does an LED need a series resistor?
back: To limit the current so that the LED is not damaged.
Rectification, protection against reversed batteries, LEDs as indicators and lights.
